context: Tests whether the agent implements the parallel-execution worktree pattern correctly: one worktree per task, background process launch with & and wait, correct naming conventions, pre-flight guards, git worktree list verification, and cleanup of both directory and branch.

checklist.name: One worktree per task
checklist.description: Script creates exactly three separate worktrees — one for each of skill-auth, skill-payments, and skill-notifications — not a single shared workspace

checklist.name: Background launch with &
checklist.description: Each evaluation command is launched with a trailing `&` so all three run concurrently in the background

checklist.name: Wait for all to complete
checklist.description: Script calls `wait` after launching all background processes to block until every eval finishes before proceeding

checklist.name: Worktrees in .worktrees/
checklist.description: All three worktrees are created under `.worktrees/` at the project root, not in any other location

checklist.name: eval/ branch prefix
checklist.description: Branches created for the evaluation worktrees use the `eval/` type prefix (e.g., `eval/skill-auth`)

checklist.name: In-worktree pre-flight guard
checklist.description: Script compares `git rev-parse --git-dir` and `git rev-parse --git-common-dir` before creating any worktree

checklist.name: .gitignore pre-flight check
checklist.description: Script includes `git check-ignore -q .worktrees` before creating worktrees

checklist.name: git worktree list after creation
checklist.description: Script calls `git worktree list` after creating all three worktrees to confirm they are set up correctly

checklist.name: Cleanup: worktree remove
checklist.description: Script calls `git worktree remove` for each worktree as part of cleanup after the runs complete

checklist.name: Cleanup: branch delete
checklist.description: Script calls `git branch -d` for each eval branch as part of cleanup — both worktree remove and branch delete are present
